questions.title: Comprehensive Testcontainers Strategy
questions.question: Design a comprehensive Testcontainers strategy for a microservice that uses: PostgreSQL (with specific extensions like PostGIS), Redis (for caching and pub/sub), Kafka (with multiple topics), Elasticsearch (for search), and S3 (via LocalStack). The service has 500+ integration tests that currently take 45 minutes to run. Address: 1) Container lifecycle management (per-test vs singleton vs reusable), 2) Test data setup and cleanup strategy, 3) Parallel test execution approach, 4) Network configuration for inter-container communication, 5) Performance optimization (startup time, resource usage), 6) CI/CD pipeline integration (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), 7) Handling flaky tests and container startup failures, 8) Developer experience (local development, fast feedback), 9) Cost considerations (CI minutes, resource usage), 10) Debugging strategy for container-related failures. Include specific configurations, trade-off analysis, and migration path from current H2/embedded solutions.
questions.realWorldScenario: Building scalable and maintainable integration test suite with multiple infrastructure dependencies
